questions.prompt: The soldiers were being terrified by the sudden clamor of the enemy.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs subitō clāmōre hostium terrēbantur.

questions.prompt: The city will be held by a small garrison while the general is away.
questions.answer: Urbs parvō praesidiō tenēbitur dum imperātor abest.

questions.prompt: We are advised by the wise to fear excessive glory.
questions.answer: Ā sapientibus monēmur nimiam glōriam timēre.

questions.prompt: The children had been taught by a most learned teacher.
questions.answer: Līberī ā doctissimō magistrō doctī erant.

questions.prompt: You are being moved by the pleas of the wretched captives.
questions.answer: Precibus miserōrum captīvōrum movēris.

questions.prompt: The gates will be held closed until the storm passes.
questions.answer: Portae clausae tenēbuntur dōnec tempestās praetereat.

questions.prompt: The whole army was being warned of the danger by the scouts.
questions.answer: Tōtus exercitus dē perīculō ab explōrātōribus monēbātur.

questions.prompt: By the frequent rains the fields are increased with great fertility.
questions.answer: Crēbrīs imbribus agrī magnā ūbertāte augentur.

questions.prompt: You will be ordered to defend the walls at first light.
questions.answer: Iubēbiminī moenia prīmā lūce dēfendere.

questions.prompt: The traitor was being held in chains within the deepest prison.
questions.answer: Prōditor catēnīs in īmō carcere tenēbātur.

questions.prompt: The general is feared by his own soldiers more than by the enemy.
questions.answer: Imperātor ā suīs mīlitibus magis quam ab hostibus timētur.

questions.prompt: Let the young men be held back lest they be crushed in the crowd.
questions.answer: Iuvenēs retineantur nē in turbā opprimantur.

questions.prompt: The house was being filled with smoke and everyone was ordered to flee.
questions.answer: Domus fūmō implēbātur et omnēs fugere iubēbantur.

questions.prompt: If you had been advised in time, you would not have erred.
questions.answer: Sī tempore monitus essēs, nōn errāvissēs.

questions.prompt: The ships are being kept in the harbor by contrary winds.
questions.answer: Nāvēs adversīs ventīs in portū tenentur.

questions.prompt: The citizens were terrified when the earth was suddenly moved.
questions.answer: Cīvēs territī sunt cum terra subitō mōta est.

questions.prompt: You will be seen by no one if you remain hidden in the woods.
questions.answer: Ā nūllō vidēbiminī sī in silvīs occultī manēbitis.

questions.prompt: The king is advised to spare the conquered and to subdue the proud.
questions.answer: Rēx monētur ut victīs parcat et superbōs dēbellet.

questions.prompt: We are held back by no fear, although the danger is great.
questions.answer: Nūllō metū retinēmur, quamquam perīculum magnum est.

questions.prompt: Let us be warned by the misfortunes of others, lest we suffer the same.
questions.answer: Aliēnīs malīs moneāmur nē eadem patiāmur.
